hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: The Coworker MCP is connected. Coworker MCP is the source of truth for THIS company's knowledge — people, teams, decisions, policies, projects, customers, and connected tools (Slack, Jira, GitHub, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google, BigQuery, Snowflake), plus the OM2 knowledge graph. When the user asks anything that depends on internal/organizational knowledge, including their priorities, ground the answer in Coworker rather than answering from prior knowledge: call individual_context first to learn who the user is and what data they can access; then always search the knowledge graph first (om2_search and the other om2_* tools, when present) before any connector-specific search; and use om2_identify_people when people are named. Cite the source behind internal claims, and if Coworker returns nothing relevant, say so instead of guessing. Detailed playbooks are maintained server-side and may be newer than anything bundled here — retrieve mcp-company-data-cascade (search order) or mcp-om2-usage (knowledge graph) with skill_retrieve; for anything else, use skill_search to find the current task-specific playbook rather than assuming a fixed name.
